articles.title: air-rs added to PyPI
articles.summary: S.L.I.P. (Slipstream Layer Inference Protocol) addresses the challenge of running large language models that exceed VRAM capacity. This protocol streams model weights directly from NVMe storage using memory-mapping (mmap), enabling execution of massive models like 70B-parameter ones on systems with less VRAM. This innovation enhances accessibility and efficiency for advanced AI development and deployment.

articles.title: mnemo-claude added to PyPI
articles.summary: Mnemo is a new Claude Code plugin that uses Obsidian to create a self-organizing knowledge base from coding sessions. It ensures Claude effectively 'never forgets' learned information, continuously enhancing its memory and efficiency. This innovation highlights AI's growing role in streamlining knowledge retention, a vital skill for effective decision-making in any complex field.

articles.title: Russian attacks kill 5 and wound more than 30 in Ukraine's Dnipro
articles.summary: Russian drone and missile strikes targeted the Ukrainian city of Dnipro, killing at least five people and wounding 34, according to local authorities. This incident highlights the continuous civilian casualties and humanitarian impact of the ongoing conflict. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the volatile geopolitical situation and the importance of understanding international conflicts and their human costs.

articles.title: Flying Gloves worn by Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor during Falklands War go on sale for £2,000
articles.summary: Flying gloves worn by Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor (Prince Andrew) during the 1982 Falklands War are now on sale for £2,000. He gained significant popularity for piloting a helicopter during the conflict, demonstrating royal family involvement in military operations. This historical item connects to a pivotal modern naval-air engagement, offering insight for aspirants into defence history and contributions.

articles.title: NFL Mock Draft: Day 2 picks
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles are projected to make three selections in Friday night's draft. Key prospects mentioned include Denzel Boston (WR, Washington), Emmanuel McNeil Warren (S, Toledo), and Zion Youn (Buffalo). This update concerns American professional sports, specifically the National Football League (NFL) player draft. It details team strategies for acquiring new talent in their roster build-up.
